concerns.text: FR-001 mandates download 'using wget or curl'; T001 implements it via openneuro-py or the S3 HTTPS endpoint. The functional outcome (download + checksums) is preserved, but the tool constraint is silently relaxed without a kickback entry. Either add an equivalent-form note to the kickback list or implement via curl/wget as written.

FR-012(1) requires dataset ID/URL verification BEFORE download, but the check lives in T010 while T001 (download) is first in execution order; the dependency table claims 'T010 gates T001' which is temporally impossible as sequenced. T001 should invoke the dataset-ID verification check itself (or the check must be extracted into T001) so the pre-download gate actually precedes download.

The per-subject tier data/results/metrics_per_subject.csv (T003) has no schema and no contract test in T006, leaving FR-014's 'all data and output' validation partial for that artifact. The two-tier resolution is documented as a kickback, but T006 should at minimum validate the per-subject file's columns/enum values until the schema reconciliation lands.
